text: ヒトカゲが　いいか！

structure.jp: ヒトカゲが　いいか！
structure.en: so Charmander is the one you want!

patterns.name: 〜がいい
patterns.explanation: A thing followed by がいい says that this is the one you pick or want. ヒトカゲがいい = 'Charmander is the one I want'.

patterns.name: 〜か (realization)
patterns.explanation: か said with a falling voice is not a question here; the speaker is taking in what he just learned. いいか = 'so that's the one you want'.
